sections.name: Hero
texts: The app that shows its workon every number.
Log food your way. Review ingredients and nutrition, track your lifts, and see your daily targets and progress together in COR.

sections.name: Food Suggestions
texts: The 3D food icons are interactable and hovering over them shows which food you should probably eat. That’s what the app will do for you.

sections.name: Meal Deconstruct
texts: The oil you can’t see still counts.
A photo cannot show every ingredient. COR asks about hidden oil, butter, sauce or cheese, and lets you choose a portion size before estimating your meal. Review and edit the result before logging it.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
texts: The things people ask before they download.

features.title: A plan you can review first.
features.description: Use your setup answers to explore a suggested goal and personalized calorie and macro targets. Review your plan before signing in to keep it.

features.title: Log it however it arrives.
features.description: Search, scan a recognized barcode or log manually. COR Pro adds meal-photo estimates, nutrition-label photos, menu scanning and text estimates, all saved to your daily log.

features.title: Food data with context.
features.description: Search food databases and recognized products. Where available, review nutrition and ingredient information before choosing a serving and saving it to your log.

features.title: Look beyond the calories.
features.description: See an ingredient-by-ingredient breakdown and the reasons behind COR’s product grade. Allergens, nutrition and processing references are shown separately where information is available.

faq.a: COR is coming soon for iPhone, with a companion Apple Watch app. This page shows features built into the current app. Download links will be added when access opens.

faq.q: Do I need an account to try it?
faq.a: You can answer the setup questions and review your suggested plan before signing in. COR supports Sign in with Apple and Google when you are ready to save it.

faq.q: What can I use without Pro?
faq.a: Your plan, targets and manual workout tracking remain available without Pro. The core app also includes food search, manual logging, recognized barcode lookup, strength history and Apple Health integration. Pro adds AI tools such as meal estimates, menu scanning and coaching.

No. A photo result is an estimate. Before analyzing a meal, COR lets you add ingredients the camera may miss, choose a portion size and add notes. You can review and edit the nutrition before logging it.

faq.q: What does the product grade mean?
faq.a: COR applies its ingredient rules to the available ingredient list and explains the findings. Nutrition, allergens and processing references are shown separately where data is available. A product grade is information to help you compare foods, not a medical assessment.

faq.q: How does the goal score work?
faq.a: The score combines nutrition, training, hydration and measured recovery into a breakdown you can inspect. Missing data is handled explicitly instead of being treated as a measured result. It tracks progress toward your goals, not your overall health.

faq.q: Does COR work with Apple Health and Apple Watch?
faq.a: Yes. Apple Health connects supported activity, sleep, body measurements and nutrition data with your permission. The Watch companion lets you follow a workout, adjust reps and weight, complete sets and manage rest.

faq.q: What happens when I use AI features?
faq.a: AI features require consent and can send the content needed for the request to an external AI provider—for example a meal photo or food description. The app includes separate AI privacy controls. Core manual tracking does not require those AI features.
